title: Ernest P. Worrell: The Beloved Goofball's Movie Universe
imageHint: The rubber-faced character in his signature denim vest and baseball cap, ready to cause chaos
description: Jim Varney's Ernest P. Worrell became a cultural phenomenon through a series of comedy films that defined family entertainment in the late 80s and 90s. Know what I mean, Vern?

questions.question: What is Ernest's famous catchphrase that he says to his unseen neighbor?
questions.explanation: Ernest's signature catchphrase "Know what I mean, Vern?" became iconic, spoken to his off-screen neighbor Vern who was never shown on camera.

questions.question: What was the first theatrical Ernest movie, released in 1987?
questions.explanation: "Ernest Goes to Camp" (1987) was Ernest's first feature film, where he works as a handyman at a summer camp and eventually becomes a counselor to a group of juvenile delinquents.

questions.question: In which Ernest movie does he travel back in time and meet historical figures including Benjamin Franklin?
questions.explanation: In "Ernest Rides Again" (1993), Ernest discovers a time machine and travels through different historical periods, including meeting Benjamin Franklin and other historical figures.

questions.question: What actor played Ernest P. Worrell in all the theatrical films?
questions.explanation: Jim Varney created and portrayed Ernest P. Worrell throughout the character's entire run, from commercials to TV shows to feature films until his death in 2000.

questions.question: In "Ernest Scared Stupid" (1991), what type of creatures does Ernest accidentally unleash?
questions.explanation: In "Ernest Scared Stupid," Ernest accidentally releases an ancient troll named Trantor who can turn children into wooden dolls, creating an army of trolls that terrorize the town.
